custom_logic_notes: UltraFatl is a custom multi-step adaptive smoothing indicator using JJMA and other advanced algorithms from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The signal logic uses buffer index 2 which likely represents a signal line or state value. Entry signal: BUY when Value[1]>4 (previous bar bullish state) AND Value[0]<5 && Value[0]!=0 (current bar signal transition). SELL when Value[1]<5 && Value[1]!=0 (previous bar bearish state) AND Value[0]>4 (current bar signal transition). The indicator appears to output integer-like state values (0-9 range based on nStepsTotal=10). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose helper functions with global variable management. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the last completed bar (not the forming bar), which is good for backtesting accuracy.
python_conversion_notes: Major challenges: (1) UltraFatl indicator must be fully reimplemented in Python - it uses CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh with JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA smoothing algorithms, none of which are standard TA-Lib functions. (2) The indicator computes adaptive multi-step smoothing: first pass with period stepping from StartLength by nStep up to nStepsTotal steps, then a second smoothing pass. (3) TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions need translation for position management. (4) The signal logic uses buffer index 2 specifically - need to understand what UltraFatl outputs on each buffer. (5) Applied_price_ enum includes custom price types (TrendFollow_1, TrendFollow_2) that need implementation. Recommendation: Find the UltraFatl.mq5 source to understand all 3 buffers and the smoothing algorithm internals before conversion.
